# House yeast

Rules learned from reviews of Foedrum's own pull requests (ADR 0122), for the files this session reads or changes (ADR 0271). Follow them where your change meets them: /brew-review looks for what they describe.

## adr-states-future-work-as-future (semantic)

An ADR, design page or prompt names behaviour of an open issue as future work (when #<n> comes, it will…), never in the present tense, and says when a function it names has no caller yet, so a reader never expects what the code does not do yet.
